[name="闪灵"]丽兹……？
[stopmusic(fadetime=2)]
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="闪灵看到了那棵树上停歇着一只黑色的羽兽，它虚弱地蜷缩在枯枝圈出的王冠之上。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n它回望着闪灵，鸣管中震颤出的哀鸣充满律动——",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="*古老的萨卡兹语*。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="枯枝的王冠中飘落下一支黑羽。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n小小的黑羽，遮挡了所有人的眼睛。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[name="？？？"]你引我至此。
[name="？？？"]而我来接你回家，丽兹。
[playMusic(intro="$plot_intro", key="$plot_loop", volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]Mon3tr！
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10002",focus="m")]
[CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$char_Mon3tr")]
[name="Mon3tr"]（高昂的嘶鸣）
[charslot]
[dialog]
[name="？？？"]回去。
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0.7, r=0.95, g=0.95, b=0.95, fadetime=0.02, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$p_imp_whip_h", volume=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_land_impact")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0.95, g=0.95, b=0.95, fadetime=0.25, block=true)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.6, xstrength=5, ystrength=8, vibrato=30, randomness=90, block=true)]
[delay(time=1)]
[name="？？？"]结构真脆弱，看来特雷西斯的剑比想象中还要锋利。
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_walk_n")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m",duration=2)]
[delay(time=3)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_179_cgbird_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="夜莺"]闪灵，小心！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]丽兹，没事，他伤不到我。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]你退步了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]这样会让我很头疼，将你的肉体重新调回巅峰的状态会占用很多的实验时间。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]你竟然愿意离开你那污秽的巢穴……
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="那只黑色的羽兽停歇在了赦罪师手中的枯枝之上。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n丰盛的羽毛覆盖在健硕的躯干上，闪耀着光泽。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n它转瞬便于腐败中重生。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]看来有什么事情令你也感到焦急。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]我们已经来到了那扇大门之前。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]哪怕尚只是轻叩大门，就已经大大加快了我们实验的进度。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]最后的仪式你必须出席——
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]Mon3tr，熔毁！
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10002",focus="m")]
[CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$Mon3tr_n")]
[name="Mon3tr"]（愤怒的嘶吼）
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]五分钟就足够，萨卢斯，用生命阻止她。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]别让他们打扰我。
[charslot]
[dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_653_1#2$1",focus="m",duration=1)]
[delay(time=2)]
[name="萨卢斯"]当然，首领。
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10002",focus="m")]
[dialog]
[CameraShake(duration=5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$e_skill_ignite_cast", volume=0.6)]
[PlaySound(key="$p_skill_chimera", volume=1)]
[Effect(name="$e_amiya_atk_01", layer = 1)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.8, r=1, g=1, b=1, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.8, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.8, r=1, g=1, b=1, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=false)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="黑色的绸缎垂下。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n嘶吼的怪物被层层束缚，可供它挣扎的空间越来越小。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10002",focus="m")]
[CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$char_Mon3tr")]
[name="Mon3tr"]（痛苦的嘶吼）
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]……黑色的法术？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]那是……阿米娅的？你们把阿米娅怎么了？！
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#2",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]……不。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#2",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]你们没有打败阿米娅。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_653_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="萨卢斯"]我本可以将魔王无恙地献给首领，可惜。
[name="萨卢斯"]不过没关系，只是看见，也足够让赝品更进一步。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_653_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="萨卢斯"]所以，小怪物，不要妄图打扰首领，你现在得陪我去其他地方老实待着！
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10002",focus="m")]
[PlaySound(key="$char_Mon3tr")]
[name="Mon3tr"]（愤怒的哀鸣）
[dialog]
[charslot(duration=1)]
[delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#3",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]Mon3tr！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]凯尔希医生，你还不能乱动。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]我说过，你我再见面只会是在战场上。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]哦？那为何此刻还要隐藏自己的剑？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]你离家时，曾立誓断绝家族的血统，我无时无刻不期盼你回归家族履行誓言。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]我给了你时间，你却一次次让我失望。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]本来，我们该诞下下一个我。那将是近百年来，最空灵的血脉。
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=1, r=1, g=1, b=1, afrom=0, rfrom=0, gfrom=0, bfrom=0, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$p_imp_whip_h", volume=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_land_impact")]
[Blocker(a=0, fadetime=1.5, block=false)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=10, ystrength=12, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_179_cgbird_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="夜莺"]唔……！
[dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[PlaySound(key="$swordtsing4")]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_land_impact")]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=10, ystrength=15, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]……唔。
